score_catch: compute a single regret-based score for the catch experiment from a pandas DataFrame
plot_learning_catch: generate learning curve plots for the catch experiment with a baseline regret dashed line
plot_seeds_catch: plot individual run returns over time for the catch experiment colored by a variable
review_score: review the score function that calculates average regret score using a baseline of 1.6
summarize_plot_learning: summarize the plot_learning function that creates regret learning curves with a horizontal baseline
